display.purpose: 53 / 43 / 34px Montserrat. Theme capacity only — no product surface uses a display size.

heading.purpose: 27px semibold Montserrat. Theme capacity; the shell has nothing at this scale. h3/h4 are bold (700).

title.purpose: 14px semibold. Page titles, pane header names, empty-state headings.

body.purpose: 14px on a 20px line. The workhorse: message text, contact names, previews, form content.

label.purpose: 11px medium (text-sm). Timestamps, metadata, chip text, filter labels. Sentence case. This is BELOW the 12px floor the system requires — the theme clamps nothing. See DESIGN.md Known drift 2.

supporting.purpose: 12px, pinned by hand via --text-supporting-size. Astryx Badge, Banner, chat metadata, breadcrumbs. Currently the only thing holding the readable floor.

code.purpose: 14px JetBrains Mono. Named by the theme and declared nowhere, so it resolves to the platform monospace stack.

shadows.name: shadow-low
shadows.purpose: Every AppPane, and cards at rest. No mode switch: in dark mode this paints near-black on near-black and contributes nothing.

shadows.name: shadow-med
shadows.purpose: Hover and mid-elevation containers. Differs from shadow-low only in the second layer blur.

shadows.name: shadow-high
shadows.purpose: Popovers, dropdowns, dialogs. In light mode this is the ONLY thing separating them from the pane: card, popover and surface are all #ffffff.

shadows.name: shadow-inset-selected
shadows.purpose: Ring-style selection emphasis where a real border would shift layout. Neutral, matching the accent.

shadows.name: shadow-inset-status
shadows.purpose: The success, warning and error inset rings are all this same neutral gray, so a success ring and an error ring are indistinguishable. See DESIGN.md Known drift 8.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover and selection tints. Min 95ms, max 165ms.

motion.name: duration-medium
motion.purpose: Panel and sheet transitions. Min 225ms, max 400ms.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Theme capacity; nothing in the shell runs this long.

motion.name: unread-count-emphasis
motion.purpose: The one authored animation. Scales 0.92 to 1 and fades 0.55 to 1 from left center so a changing count draws the eye without moving its neighbors. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. Its 280ms matches no token.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The accent fill — the far end of the neutral ramp, not a hue. A pill, like every button in the product. One per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #25252a; color: #ffffff; font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4286; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 125ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3b3b3f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #25252a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: An outline, not a fill: transparent with a 1.5px emphasized border. In dark mode that border is 2.66:1 against the pane, below the 3:1 non-text requirement.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #25252a; font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4286; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1.5px solid #83838a; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 125ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #25252a0f; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #25252a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: A pastel well, not a fill. The red plate with its own vivid text, 7.25:1 computed. The quietest colored object on screen; weight for a destructive action belongs in the copy and the dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: #f9dcd7; color: #58413e; font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4286; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #25252a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Semantic Badge
components.description: info / success / warning / error all resolve to categorical plates under stone. There is no saturated signal fill any more, so a semantic badge and a categorical chip are the same kind of object.
components.css: .ds-badge-info { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #d7e4f5; color: #3c4856; font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4545; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Categorical Badge
components.description: A T90 plate carrying T30 same-hue text in light, inverting to a solid T35 plate with T90 text in dark. Every hue lands at ~7.2:1 light and ~6.0:1 dark by construction.
components.css: .ds-badge-neutral { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #e2e2e8; color: #46464b; font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4545; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Transparent fill, hairline border, 8px corner. Status borders are softened to T60 across all nine input components: ~3.17:1, clearing the 3:1 non-text requirement with almost nothing spare.
components.css: .ds-input { background: transparent; color: #25252a; font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4286; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e2e8; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #83838a; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #25252a; outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Conversation List Item
components.description: The most-read surface in the product. A transparent row in a scrollable listbox, never card-wrapped. Hover is the accent at 4%, selection at 10%, and hover is scoped so it can never override selection.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; background: transparent; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 125ms ease; } .ds-row:hover { background: #25252a0a; } .ds-row[data-selected="true"] { background: #25252a1a; } .ds-row-name { font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #25252a; } .ds-row-time { font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: #83838a; }

components.name: App Pane
components.description: The shell unit: a fill, a 12px radius, a shadow, and scroll containment. What separates two panes is the canvas showing between them, never a border. Below md the frame drops entirely and panes go full-bleed.
components.css: .ds-pane { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px #28282A0D, 0 4px 8px #28282A1A; overflow: hidden; } .ds-pane-header { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 56px; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e2e8; font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #25252a; }

components.name: Side Nav Item
components.description: The rail is the only persistent chrome; there is no top bar. Selection is a quiet accent-tone fill, the same grammar as a conversation row.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #25252a; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #25252a0a; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: #25252a1a; }

components.name: Error Banner
components.description: A full-measure status surface is a tinted field, not a plate and not an outlined box. The theme rebinds the text tokens inside the banner scope so icon, title, description and action all arrive in one tone.
components.html: Сессия истеклаВойдите снова, чтобы продолжить.
components.css: .ds-banner-error { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; background: #f9dcd7; color: #58413e; font-family: Figtree, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4286; padding: 12px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; }

narrative.overview:
Rezzy's shell is a canvas with elevated panes inset into it: the conversation list, the thread, the contact panel, a settings page. What separates two regions is the canvas showing between them, not a line drawn across them. That structural claim has now survived two full changes of palette, so treat it as the durable identity.

What changed is the material, and it changed in the direction of quiet. The previous theme was a chroma-0 spine with a bright lime accent and saturated signal fills. Stone removes both loud halves. The accent is now the far end of the neutral ramp (#25252a light, #f3f3f5 dark), so a primary button is a near-black pill and there is no brand hue anywhere in the interface. The saturated status fills are gone with it: every colored object is now a muted pastel plate carrying same-hue text, at chroma low enough that a badge reads as a tinted gray until you look at it. The system gained uniformity — one construction, one contrast figure — and lost volume. Nothing on screen can shout any more.

The neutral spine is one OKLCH ramp at H=291, C=3 — not chroma 0. The cast is invisible alone and visible the moment a true gray or a platform brand color sits beside it, which is why every gray comes from stonePalettes rather than from Tailwind.

Depth inverted by mode. Light mode has no tonal ladder at all: pane, card and popover are all #ffffff, and a soft two-layer shadow is the only separator. Dark mode is the opposite, a real five-step ladder from #111015 up to #3b3b3f, with shadows that do nothing because they are near-black at 5-10% over a near-black surface and the previous theme's 1px white inset rim is gone. Each mode carries elevation by exactly the mechanism the other one lacks.
keyCharacteristics: Canvas and panes: the shell is a canvas, each region is an inset pane with a fill, a radius, a gap, and a lift
Gutter separation: the canvas showing between panes divides regions; hairlines rule only within a pane
Near-neutral spine: one H=291 C=3 ramp carries every surface, rule, and running-text tone
No brand hue: the accent is the ramp dark end in light and its light end in dark
One color language: muted pastel plate plus same-hue text, for categories and for status alike
Light lifts by shadow, dark lifts by tone, and neither mode has both
Two type tiers: 14px body, 11px metadata — the second below the system's own 12px floor
Pill buttons, and a radius scale that dropped at every step: 2 / 4 / 8 / 12 / 24px
rules: The Near-Neutral Spine Rule. Every structural surface, rule and running-text tone comes from the H=291 C=3 ramp. Nothing that is merely structure takes a hue, and stone has no sanctioned hue at all — the accent is the ramp’s own endpoint.

The Accent Cannot Be Split By Token Rule. The Tailwind bridge alias --color-accent-bg is overwritten by any theme that assigns --color-accent, so text-accent, ring-accent and bg-accent-bg collapse to one value. Keep --color-accent and --color-text-accent byte-identical; a color too bright to be text belongs on a component override.

The One Language Rule. There is no loud status variant left. Do not reintroduce a saturated fill for one component to make it stand out — it would be the only object in the product outside the system.
The Chip Carries Its Own Text Rule. A categorical plate is never combined with text-primary. Each hue’s vivid token is the only correct foreground on its plate; reach for the component variant.
The Plate Is Solid In Both Modes Rule. A dark categorical background is an opaque T35 tone, not an alpha overlay, so it does not adapt to what sits behind it.
The Light Mode Has No Raised Tone Rule. bg-card, bg-popover and bg-surface are all #ffffff, so a light-mode card is a shadow and nothing else. Never suppress it.
The Rim Is Gone Rule. Dark-mode shadows paint near-black on near-black and there is no inset rim, so a dark overlay is separated by tone or by nothing. Popover over card is 1.03:1.
The Recess Is Pane-Relative Rule. bg-muted recesses in light and raises in dark — 1.54:1 up against the dark pane, the largest single surface step in the theme.

The 12px Floor Rule. Nothing should render below 12px, and the theme does not currently hold this: text-sm is 11px and text-xs is 9px because stone clamps nothing. Fix at the theme, not per component.

The Cyrillic Coverage Rule. baseLocale is ru, so Cyrillic must be covered by a declared face before any generic fallback. Stone names Figtree, Montserrat and JetBrains Mono; none has an @font-face in the repo, so the whole interface renders in the system UI stack.

The Brand-Hex Exception. Telegram #26A5E4, WhatsApp #25D366 and Instagram #E1306C in src/entities/channel/lib/platform.ts are the only raw hexes permitted — and under stone they are the most saturated objects that will ever appear on screen.
dos: Treat src/themes/stone/stoneTheme.ts as the source of truth for every token; it is applied at runtime by <Theme> in src/main.tsx, with no build step and no compiled theme.css.
Pick new color values as a named stop on a stonePalettes ramp — that is what keeps every plate at the same contrast ratio.
Add a self-hosted @font-face in src/fonts/fonts.css for any family the theme names, and confirm it ships Cyrillic. Naming a family does not load it; this has gone wrong four times.
Separate sibling regions with the canvas gutter: compose AppPanes and let AppPaneGroup own the space between them.
Give a light-mode surface a shadow token when it should read as raised, and give a dark-mode overlay a tonal step or a border-border.
Use the Tailwind bridge names (bg-surface, text-primary, border-border, bg-blue-subtle, text-blue-vivid) rather than raw var(--color-*) in class strings.
Express state as the accent at low alpha: bg-primary/4 hover, bg-primary/10 selected, bg-primary/5 quiet plate.
Use text-primary/70 where copy needs to recede in light mode, until text-secondary clears 4.5:1.
Put body copy on text-base and metadata on text-sm, and escalate through weight and opacity rather than a third size.
Define all seven states for every interactive component, and say explicitly when one does not apply.
Give every pane overflow-hidden, its own overflow-y-auto scroll region, and min-h-0 through the flex chain.
Guard every transition and animation with motion-reduce:.
donts: Do not assume Tailwind default scales: text-sm is 11px, text-base is 14px, rounded-sm is 4px, rounded-md is 8px, rounded-lg is 12px, rounded-xl is 24px. Not one type step matches Tailwind.
Do not reintroduce text-xs or anything below text-sm — they resolve to 9px and 7px.
Do not name a Latin-only family as the body face without a Cyrillic-covering face directly behind it, and never put a generic fallback ahead of that face.
Do not write border-border/60. The border token is opaque in light mode and the modifier thins it past visibility. 30 usages remain.
Do not rely on bg-muted to recess in dark mode, or on a shadow to raise anything in dark mode.
Do not suppress a Card or Popover shadow in light mode; there is no tone under it.
Do not override a button border-radius — the pill is a theme-level decision on components.button.base.
Do not reintroduce a saturated fill for one component to make it stand out.
Do not put text-primary on a categorical plate; use the hue vivid token or the component variant that binds it.
Do not pair a -muted well with its own status tone in dark mode: --color-success and --color-success-muted are the same value there and the text vanishes.
Do not hardcode a hex outside the three platform brand colors.
Do not hand-roll a pane, give a pane a border, or put a hairline between two panes.
Do not card-wrap dense list rows, or nest a Card inside a shell pane.
Do not change the box metrics of anything inside the transcript for cosmetic reasons — the list measures row heights for scroll anchoring.
Do not add a decorative background, and do not add a top bar.
Do not cite a verification command for anything in this document; none exists.
